items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I get rid of it because of the integration of the commander who liked to compose music. The Commandante Almay, that was his name. He loved to compose the little songs like that, and I recorded some of his pieces, and then he liberated me from the army in six month.

ctx.x: How long were you in the army?
Almost three years, two years and a half. It was supposed to be three years, but I get rid of it because of the integration of the commander who liked to compose music. The
Commandante Almay, that was his name. He loved to compose the little songs like that, and I recorded some of his pieces, and then he liberated me from the army in six month.
